speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: IMDA has been leading this effort, engaging industry players and Government agencies in early trials and test-bedding.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: The feedback gained through IMDA’s public consultation will inform our policies to facilitate the 5G network rollout and help identify innovative and impactful 5G applications.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: I encourage all industry players and other stakeholders to actively participate in this consultation.

speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (Jurong)
text: The question is being asked in the light of the United States (US) pressurising allies not to use certain 5G vendors in their respective countries.

speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (Jurong)
text: Thirdly, is the Government prepared to bring more telcos into Singapore in tandem with the 5G network, or does the Minister feel that it is already optimal in terms of the number of telcos in Singapore?

speaker: Mr S Iswaran
text: Speaker, I thank the Member for his supplementary questions.

speaker: Mr S Iswaran
text: First, in terms of the 5G network infrastructure, the approach is simple.

speaker: Mr S Iswaran
text: That would be the approach we will take.

speaker: Mr S Iswaran
text: It is not different to the approach that has been taken in other parts of the world.

speaker: Mr S Iswaran
text: I will take the third question next – are we open to more telcos?

speaker: Mr S Iswaran
text: Right now, our focus is on the deployment of 5G, working with the existing suite of telco players that we have in Singapore.

speaker: Mr S Iswaran
text: And we want to ensure its reliability through these elements.

speaker: Mr S Iswaran
text: So, that is our focus and we are engaging with the industry in consultation to assess how best to achieve that objective for, not just individual networks, but for our system as a whole.
